verdict.rationale: Circle documents some settlement-timing and fee facts. CPN is described as moving money "near-instantly, 24/7", Gateway transfers "instantly", Mint conversion is "at no additional cost", and CCTP exposes an API for querying Fast Transfer fees. These are high-level claims, not a documented payment-to-available-balance timeline or a per-rail fee schedule, and the pricing page offers only solution guidance. Missing for 10: documented settlement timing per rail from payment to available balance, a published fee schedule per rail, and any statements, reports or accounting exports.

support.subject: As a finance lead, settlement is legible — documented timing from payment to available balance, published fees per rail, and statements or reports my accounting can consume
